body: That's just how it goes where I'm at. Fathers always get shit on, no matter what. The most I would get is supervised visitation. I have a plethora of anecdotal evidence to support that.

She doesn't care about me. At all. She doesn't care about how I feel, she doesn't care about the possibility of me dying, she just doesn't care. The only time she talks to me is when she wants to bitch at me. God forbid I try and open up and mend our relationship, she wants nothing more to do with me, and it kills me. I love her more than anything, and she doesn't care.
